scope: Meowdoku-inspired play-along onboarding; no level-pack regeneration, new sound work or external integration
implementation: First screen invites a real double tap; remove four up-front reading pages from new attempts.
Player performs mark, undo, horizontal/vertical swipe and rule-based exclusions before finding the remaining animals.
Separate visual rule focus from permitted input targets; every exclusion requires real player input.
Final independent stage allows ordinary input, including wrong guesses; optional free visual hint does not change board or inventory.
Persist plan version, hint attempt and completion attempt; v1/v2 unfinished lessons retain their original steps.
Final correct submission commits tutorial completion, win and unlock together; duplicate callbacks do not award again.
Native stroke identity and model guard prevent a held swipe from applying to a later teaching step.
Chinese and English copy and tutorial-complete Start Game route into level 2.

iphone17Pro.path: entire current tutorial, last free play/optional hint, completion, Start game to L2

iphone17e.path: entire current tutorial, final free play/optional hint, completion, Start Game to L2

firstAppAttempt.resolution: Updated two historical test assumptions: current packaged v2 row/column order, and exact recognizer identity instead of obsolete fixed count 3. Production behavior unchanged by these corrections.

verification.seedRebuild: level1-rebuild.json; current v4 and archived v3 exact. Historical demo-connected-v2 has never been supported by this metadata rebuild API; its full snapshot and new teaching path were tested separately.
verification.actualColdRecovery: Each new step and partial swipe/exclusion, all eight generated sample seeds, v1 absent-version payload and v2 saved steps; completion and hint cold recovery.

compactLayout.cases: existing hint, explicit v2 read panel, v3 first action, v3 final free play/free hint, free tool

limits: Not a fresh full native Meowdoku tutorial playthrough in this round; recorded comparison source/version boundaries are explicit.
Not a frame-by-frame animation/timing match; own generated map changes the order of some deductions.
No current-build physical-iPhone installation or human usability sign-off.
Environment candidate/reinstall helpers updated and compiled, but the full multi-environment reinstall matrix was not repeated.
No full 88-item checklist or formal app-store/external-service acceptance.
supervision: generation_progress_manager reviewed bounded exits and final implementation; no further feature expansion.
